commands.description: Open problem in default browser (controlled by `errorLens.searchForProblemQuery` setting).
commands.title: Search for problem

commands.description: Set editor selection to the problem range (controlled by `errorLens.selectProblemType` setting).
commands.title: Select Problem

commands.description: Exclude/Include current workspace by fs path.
commands.title: Toggle Workspace in Disabled List

commands.description: Add a comment to disable line for linter rule. Comment format is controlled by `"errorLens.disableLineComments"` setting.
commands.title: Disable line

commands.description: Search in local linter files (like `.eslintrc.json`) for the rule definition. Target files are controlled by "errorLens.lintFilePaths" setting.
commands.title: Find Linter Rule Definition

commands.description: Copy problem message to the clipboard (at the active cursor).
commands.title: Copy Problem Message

errorLens.alignMessage.markdownDescription: Align inline error message (either by starting position or ending position). Only works for monospace fonts. Set "start" and "end" to **0** to disable. ❗Will conflict with other extension decorations. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensalignmessage)

end.description: Ending column where to align decorations.

minimumMargin.description: Minimal space between line end and decoration. Very similar to the global setting `errorLens.margin`, but can only be a number of characters.

padding.description: Very similar to the global setting `errorLens.padding`, but it can only be a number (not any CSS unit like pixels). First number is top+bottom padding; Second number - left+right padding.

start.description: Starting column where to align decorations.

useFixedPosition.description: Use fixed position for decoration that has stuttering/twitching on the active line (e.g. when typing). Will prevent hover over decoration text.

errorLens.border.markdownDescription: Border of the inline message. Examples: `1px solid`, `1px dashed`, `2px dotted`, `1px solid #00000050`... Set to empty string to disable. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensborder)

errorLens.borderRadius.markdownDescription: Border radius of the inline message. Visible when `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` is set to "message". [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensborderradius)

errorLens.codeLensEnabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether to show the Error Lens as a Code Lens above the code. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenscodelensenabled)

errorLens.codeLensLength.markdownDescription: Enforce minimum and maximum length of code lens messages.

enumDescriptions: Does nothing.
Shows problems view.
Shows quick fix menu.
Search for the problem.
errorLens.codeLensOnClick.markdownDescription: Controls what do on clicking the `#errorLens.codeLensEnabled#`.

errorLens.codeLensTemplate.markdownDescription:
Template used for all messages appearing in the `#errorLens.codeLensEnabled#`. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

- `$source` - Source of diagnostic e.g. "eslint"

- `$code` - Code of the diagnostic

errorLens.decorations.markdownDescription:
Advanced decoration tweaking. Possible keys: `errorRange`, `warningRange`, `infoRange`, `hintRange`, `errorMessage`, `warningMessage`, `infoMessage`, `hintMessage`.

 Possible properties: `backgroundColor`, `color`, `outline`, `border`, ... [api](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#ThemableDecorationAttachmentRenderOptions). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensdecorations)

errorLens.delay.markdownDescription: Delay (ms) before showing problem decorations (**0** to disable). Minimum delay of **500** is enforced by the extension. `#errorLens.delayMode#` controls how to handle the delay.

errorLens.delayMode.markdownDescription: Pick which version of the delay to use.
markdownEnumDescriptions: New problems appear according to `errorLens.delay` setting. Fixed problems disappear faster.
Decorations for problems are debounced according to `errorLens.delay` setting.

errorLens.disableLineComments.markdownDescription:
Used for `errorLens.disableLine` command that adds a comment disabling linter rule for a line.
To force comment on the same line - add `SAME_LINE` to the message: `"eslint": "// eslint-disable-line $code SAME_LINE"`

errorLens.editorHoverPartsEnabled.markdownDescription: Controls which parts of the editor hover tooltip to show.

errorLens.enableOnDiffView.markdownDescription: Enable decorations when viewing a diff view in the editor (e.g. Git diff). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensenableondiffview)

errorLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls all decorations and features (except commands).

errorLens.enabledDiagnosticLevels.markdownDescription: Customize which diagnostic levels(severity) to highlight. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensenableddiagnosticlevels)

errorLens.enabledInMergeConflict.markdownDescription: Controls if decorations are shown if the editor has git merge conflict indicators `<<<<<<<` or `=======` or `>>>>>>>`.

errorLens.errorGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Error color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericoncolor)

errorLens.errorGutterIconPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to error gutter icon. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericonpath)

errorLens.excludeByMessage.markdownDescription: Exclude diagnostics by message. Excludes when the diagnostic message contains the excluding string (case-insensitive). Can use Regular Expressions (use object instead of a string).

errorLens.excludeBySource.markdownDescription:
Specify `source` or `source(code)` pair to exclude. Examples: 

```json
[
	"eslint",// exclude all problems from eslint linter
	"eslint(padded-blocks)",// exclude padded-blocks rule from eslint linter
	"Pylance(reportUndefinedVariable)",// exlude reportUndefinedVariable rule from Pylance linter
]
```

errorLens.excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Exclude files by using [glob](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) pattern. Example `["**/*.{ts,js}"]`

enumDescriptions: Highlight all problems in file
Highlight all problems in file (except the line at the cursor)
Highlight only the problem at the cursor
Highlight only closest to the cursor problem
errorLens.followCursor.markdownDescription: Highlight only portion of the problems. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfollowcursor)

errorLens.followCursorMore.markdownDescription:
Augments `#errorLens.followCursor#`.
Adds number of lines to top and bottom when `#errorLens.followCursor#` is set to `activeLine`.
 Adds number of closest problems when `#errorLens.followCursor#` is `closestProblem` [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfollowcursormore)

errorLens.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family of inline message. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontfamily). May break `#errorLens.alignMessage#`

errorLens.fontSize.markdownDescription: Font size of inline message ([CSS units](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/length)). Use negative value to have it relative to the editor's fontSize (e.g. `-3px`). May break `#errorLens.alignMessage#`. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontsize).

errorLens.fontStyleItalic.markdownDescription: When enabled - shows inline message in italic font style. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontstyleitalic)

errorLens.fontWeight.markdownDescription: Font weight of inline message. (`"normal"` is alias for 400, `"bold"` is alias for 700). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontweight)

errorLens.gutterEmoji.markdownDescription: Pick emoji symbol for gutter icon when `#errorLens.gutterIconSet#` is `emoji`. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensgutteremoji)

enumDescriptions: Similar to vscode icons in Problems Panel (old).
Similar to vscode icons in Problems Panel (new).
Similar to vscode icons in Problems Panel, only without a border.
Simple filled circle.
Simple filled square.
Simple filled square with rounded corners.
Simple one letter icon (E,W,I,H).
Emoji. (`errorLens.gutterEmoji` to control which emoji to show.)

errorLens.gutterIconsEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - shows gutter icons (In place of the debug breakpoint icon). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensguttericonsenabled)

errorLens.gutterIconsFollowCursorOverrid.markdownDescription: When enabled and `#errorLens.followCursor#` setting is not `allLines`, then gutter icons would be rendered for all problems. But line decorations (background, message) only for active line. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensguttericonsfollowcursoroverride)

errorLens.hintGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Hint color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericoncolor)

errorLens.hintGutterIconPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to hint gutter icon. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericonpath)

errorLens.ignoreDirty.markdownDescription: Controls whether to run on dirty (modified unsaved) files.

errorLens.ignoreUntitled.markdownDescription: Controls whether to run on untitled (unsaved) files.

errorLens.infoGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Info color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericoncolor)

errorLens.infoGutterIconPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to info gutter icon. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericonpath)

errorLens.light.markdownDescription: Specify color of decorations for when the light color theme is active.

errorGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Error color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

errorGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to error gutter icon for light themes.

hintGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Hint color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

hintGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to hint gutter icon for light themes.

infoGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Info color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

infoGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to info gutter icon for light themes.

warningGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Warning color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

warningGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to warning gutter icon for light themes.

errorLens.lintFilePaths.markdownDescription: Specify where to search for linter rule definitions by diagnostic source ([glob](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) for local linter files). `node_modules` folder is excluded.

errorLens.margin.markdownDescription: Distance between the last word on the line and the start of inline message ([CSS units](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/length)). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmargin)

errorLens.maxInlineMessages.markdownDescription: Limit inline messages to the lines currently visible in the editor when a file has more lines with problems than this value. VSCode creates a separate set of CSS rules for every distinct inline message, so a file with thousands of problems can freeze the editor for a long time. Line highlighting, gutter icons, problem range decorations, hovers and status bar are not affected. `0` - no limit.

enumDescriptions: The entire line is highlighted.
Inline message is highlighted.
Message is not highlighted (only has foreground colors).
errorLens.messageBackgroundMode.markdownDescription: Controls how inline message is highlighted in the editor (entire line / only message / none). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagebackgroundmode)

errorLens.messageEnabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether inline message is shown or not (Including background highlight). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessageenabled)

errorLens.messageMaxChars.markdownDescription: Cut off inline message if it's longer than this value. (Improves performance when the diagnostic message is long). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagemaxchars)

errorLens.messageTemplate.markdownDescription:
Template used for all inline messages. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

- `$source` - Source of diagnostic e.g. "eslint"

- `$code` - Code of the diagnostic [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagetemplate)

errorLens.onSave.markdownDescription: When enabled - updates decorations only on document save (manual).

errorLens.onSaveTimeout.markdownDescription: Time period (ms) that used for showing decorations after the document save (manual, not auto save).

errorLens.onSaveUpdateOnActiveEditorChan.markdownDescription: When `#errorLens.onSave#` enabled - extension still draws decorations when active/visible editors change.

errorLens.padding.markdownDescription: Padding of the inline message. Visible when `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` is set to "message". [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenspadding)

errorLens.problemRangeDecorationEnabled.markdownDescription: When checked - highlight the entire problem range. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensproblemrangedecorationenabled)

errorLens.removeLinebreaks.markdownDescription: When enabled - replaces line breaks in inline diagnostic message with whitespaces.

matcher.description: The RegExp pattern against which to match diagnostic messages

message.description: The entire replacement for messages matching matcher. Can reference match groups like $0 (entire expression), $1 (first capture group), etc.

errorLens.replace.markdownDescription: Specify message to transform. E.g. if this is configured to [{ matcher: 'foo (.*)', message: 'just $1' }], the message 'foo bar' would be displayed as 'just bar'. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensreplace)

errorLens.replaceLinebreaksSymbol.markdownDescription: Symbol to replace linebreaks. Requires enabling `#errorLens.removeLinebreaks#`.

errorLens.respectUpstreamEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - extension will take into account global VSCode setting `#problems.visibility#`. ([1.85.0 changelog](https://code.visualstudio.com/updates/v1_85#_hide-problem-decorations)).

enabled.description: When true - extension will honour VSCode setting `#problems.visibility#` and not show errors if `#problems.visibility#` is false.

errorLens.scrollbarHackEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - prevents showing horizontal scrollbar in editor (caused by inline decorations). Also prevents mouse hover at inline message. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensscrollbarhackenabled)

errorLens.searchForProblemQuery.markdownDescription: Pick query to open in default browser when searching for problem with `errorLens.searchForProblem` command.

enumDescriptions: Show closest to the cursor diagnostic.
Show closest to the cursor diagnostic (sorted by severity e.g. error will be shown before warning even if it's farther from the cursor).
Show only diagnostic that is on the same line as the cursor.
errorLens.selectProblemType.markdownDescription: Which problem to select (closest / active line) when executing `errorLens.selectProblem` command.

errorLens.statusBarColorsEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - use message decoration foreground as color of Status Bar text. Uses colors `errorLens.statusBarErrorForeground`, `errorLens.statusBarWarningForeground`, `errorLens.statusBarInfoForeground`, `errorLens.statusBarHintForeground`. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensstatusbarcolorsenabled)

errorLens.statusBarCommand.markdownDescription: Command that executes on click for Status Bar.

errorLens.statusBarIconsAlignment.markdownDescription: Choose on which side the icons status bar is on: left or right.

errorLens.statusBarIconsAtZero.markdownDescription: What to do when there are 0 errors/warnings - hide the item or strip its background color.

errorLens.statusBarIconsEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - shows highlighted error/warning icons in status bar. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensstatusbariconsenabled)

errorLens.statusBarIconsPriority.markdownDescription: Move status bar icons left or right by adjusting the number priority.

enumDescriptions: Should be the same as native status bar icons - counts all known problems from all files.
Count only problems from the Active Text Editor.
Count only problems from the Visible Text Editors.
errorLens.statusBarIconsTargetProblems.markdownDescription: Which problems to use for counting problems at icons status bar.

errorLens.statusBarIconsUseBackground.markdownDescription: When enabled - highlights status bar icons with background, when disabled - with foreground.

errorLens.statusBarMessageAlignment.markdownDescription: Choose on which side the message status bar is on: left or right.

errorLens.statusBarMessageEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - shows message in status bar. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensstatusbarmessageenabled)

errorLens.statusBarMessagePriority.markdownDescription: Move status bar message left or right by adjusting the number priority.

errorLens.statusBarMessageTemplate.markdownDescription:
Template for status bar message. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

- `$source` - Source of diagnostic e.g. "eslint"

- `$code` - Code of the diagnostic

enumDescriptions: Show closest to the cursor diagnostic.
Show closest to the cursor diagnostic sorted by severity (e.g. error will be shown before warning even if it's farther from the cursor).
Show only diagnostic that is on the same line as the cursor.
Similar to "activeLine" but follows the cursor movement inside the line.
errorLens.statusBarMessageType.markdownDescription: Pick what to show in Status Bar: closest message or only message for the active line.

errorLens.transmute.markdownDescription: Change severity or editor decoration for specific problems. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenstransmute)

dark.description: Only works for Dark color themes.

after.description: Change the properties of the inline message.

light.description: Only works for Light color themes.

after.description: Change the properties of the inline message.

severity.markdownDescription: Change problem's severity (can affect which decoration is rendered).

messageRegex.description: Match with problem's message using Regular Expressions.

errorLens.warningGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Warning color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericoncolor)

errorLens.warningGutterIconPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to warning gutter icon. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenserrorguttericonpath)

packageJSON.description: Improve highlighting of errors, warnings and other language diagnostics.
packageJSON.name: errorlens
